items.period: Shuowen small-seal style; modern vector redraw
items.tradition: Small seal script (篆書), digitally rendered
items.caption: A modern vector rendering of 汽 in Shuowen seal-script style. The cited Shuowen analysis treats 水 as the semantic element and 气 as the sound element.
items.alt: Modern vector drawing of the character 汽 in a seal-script style.
items.selection_reason: The Commons description identifies this exact file as a Shuowen seal-style depiction of 汽 and states a public-domain release. It can illustrate the dictionary-reported form, while not serving as an archaeological specimen.
items.rights: Public domain, according to the file description page.

limitations.text: The candidate is a modern digital redraw rather than an ancient artifact image. The exact Commons file page was found and its description text inspected in search output, but direct page opening returned a cache miss; the original upload link could not be independently copied. The exact-filename Commons redirect is provided.
